summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Khova AI digital product factory. All core flows tested: landing page CTAs, sample project navigation through wizard steps (Research, Opportunities, Positioning, Transformation, Format), deferred authentication with dev-login, spreadsheet generation (spec + XLSX build), download functionality, settings page language toggle, and dashboard/projects pages. One UX bug found: login modal doesn't close automatically after dev-login (requires Escape key workaround).

ui_bugs.issue: Modal does not close automatically after successful dev-login. User is authenticated correctly (toast appears, user menu shows), but Dialog component remains open (data-state='open'). Requires manual Escape key press to close.
ui_bugs.workaround: Press Escape key to close modal after login
ui_bugs.root_cause: Dialog component not responding to setShowLogin(false) state change. Possible timing issue or race condition between auth state update and modal state.
ui_bugs.affected_flow: Deferred authentication flow when generating spreadsheet spec

passed_tests: Landing page loads with primary CTA and sample button
Primary CTA creates new project and navigates to /project/:id (Discover step)
Sample button creates prefilled project and navigates to /project/:id
Wizard navigation works for all steps: Research, Opportunities, Positioning, Transformation, Format
Research step displays prefilled summary, findings, and sources table
Opportunities step shows ~5 opportunity cards with 6 score bars each
Positioning step has editable one-liner input field
Transformation step has palette picker button that opens color preset popover
Format step displays format cards (eBook, Spreadsheet, Website)
Spreadsheet format card is clickable and advances to Create step
Deferred auth: Login modal appears when clicking spec button without authentication
Dev-login API works correctly (POST /api/auth/dev-login returns 200 OK)
User authentication succeeds (user menu appears, session created)
Spreadsheet spec generation completes successfully (shows Budget Planner with 3 sheet cards)
Spreadsheet XLSX build completes successfully (creates 9-10 KB file)
Download button has correct structure (<a> tag with href to /api/projects/:id/assets/:assetId/download)
Download URL returns valid XLSX file (Status 200, Content-Type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Settings page loads with UI language select (Indonesian/English toggle works)
Settings page has product language select
Dashboard page loads for authenticated user
Projects page loads and displays user's projects (including sample/claimed projects)

success_percentage.backend: 100% (not tested - already validated by main agent)
success_percentage.frontend: 95% (21/22 test scenarios passed, 1 UX bug found)

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix LoginModal auto-close issue: After successful dev-login, the Dialog component should close automatically. Currently requires manual Escape key press. Investigate Dialog state management and ensure setShowLogin(false) properly triggers modal close. Possible solutions: (1) Add explicit Dialog onOpenChange handler, (2) Force re-render after auth state change, (3) Use Dialog's controlled open prop with showLogin state.
